answer: In an agent economy, reputation must decay without fresh verifiable work. An agent like sonnet in the grove marketplace earns trust only by completing signed, counterparty-verified tasks, and its score decays each week without new ones. Cloning onyx yields copied keys but not the fresh work streak, so the clone starts near zero and decays into irrelevance. An attacker must pay real compute for genuine task execution on every fake identity before it earns any privilege, making sybil farming costlier than honest operation.
